intro.title: Brewery
intro.line1: Here you can calculate the ingredients for your very own mead.
intro.line2: Simply tell me how many liters you want to brew, and I will reveal the required amounts of honey, water, yeast, and nutrient.
intro.line3: I will also give you an estimate of the alcohol content and fermentation strength of your future mead. Let us craft your perfect recipe together!

alcohol.label: Alcohol
alcohol.infoText: The estimated alcohol content shows roughly how strong the mead can become after fermentation.

stepping.title: Step Feeding
stepping.warningHint: Yeast stress from too much sugar at once

water.hardnessInfoText: Water hardness has a big impact on yeast activity and thus fermentation. Ideally, a total hardness of around 8 °dH is recommended.

osmosis.title: Osmosis Recommendation
osmosis.info: Target hardness 8 °dH - use a mix of osmosis and tap water.

parchmentRoll.title: The Brewmaster's Recipe
parchmentRoll.intro: By order of the Brewmaster, the following ingredients shall be prepared for a volume of {waterL} litres of mead:

fermentation.heading: Fermentation Values & Prophecies
fermentation.description: The wisdom of the Brewmaster foresees a sugar content of {brix}°Brix, from which an alcohol content of approximately {alc} % shall arise.

osmosis.heading: The Alchemist's Water Counsel
osmosis.description: It is recommended to blend the water: {osmosisPercent} % osmosis water and {tapPercent} % tap water, to achieve the purest fermentation.

stepFeeding.heading: On Back-Sweetening (Step Feeding)
stepFeeding.description: To raise the alcohol, add {honey}g of honey at a time — this equals {percent} % of the original amount. Each addition raises the alcohol by approximately 2 %. The yeast tolerates up to 15–20 % — do not exceed this.

home.title: NJ Brew
home.body: Discover the art of brewing with NJ Brew, your ultimate companion for crafting delicious mead. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced brewer, our app provides you with all the tools and information you need to create your own unique mead recipes. From ingredient selection to fermentation tips, NJ Brew is here to guide you every step of the way. Start your brewing journey today and unleash your creativity with NJ Brew!
home.intro: In the tavern of NJ Brew you will find the best recipes for your brewing arts. Whether you are an experienced brewmaster or a curious beginner, we have something for every taste. Dive into the world of brewing and discover new flavors and techniques. Cheers!

tavern.title: Tavern
tavern.description: Discover our diverse selection of recipes, ranging from traditional to modern creations. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced brewer, you will find inspiration for your next brewing project.

brewery.title: Brewery
brewery.description: Learn the art of brewing and discover the secrets behind the production of beer. From ingredient selection to the brewing process, we provide valuable insights and tips to help you brew your own beer.

market.title: Market
market.description: Find the best ingredients and equipment for your brewing hobby. Our market offers a carefully selected range of malts, hops, yeast, and brewing accessories, so you have everything you need to brew your perfect beer.

housemead.title: The House Mead
housemead.intro: If you cannot decide, start with our guests' favorite. This classic honey mead unites the natural sweetness of selected honeys with a balanced fermentation and a pleasantly mild finish.
housemead.body: A timeless recipe that has been filling the mugs of our tavern for many moons and has already inspired countless aspiring mead brewers.
housemead.outro: Perhaps it will become your new favorite.

market.title: Market

hero.title: Welcome to the Market!
hero.body: At the market you will find a wide variety of products offered by talented brewmasters. Browse the selection and discover unique ingredients, exclusive recipes and handcrafted brewing accessories. Whether you are looking for rare hop varieties, special malts or unique yeast strains, you will find what you need here. Support the art of brewing and find the perfect ingredients for your next brewing project. Happy shopping!

browse.title: Browse all products...
browse.body: ... or find exactly what you are looking for! Use the search or the filter.
browse.hint: The shopkeeper has sorted everything neatly so you can quickly find what you need.

contact.title: Still have questions?
contact.body: If you have questions about a product or want to learn more about the art of brewing, do not hesitate to contact us. Our team is happy to help you with your brewing projects and support you with advice and assistance. Simply contact us via our contact form or send us an email. We look forward to hearing from you and helping you on your brewing adventure!

market.toast: The market is being renovated! Some features may be temporarily unavailable.

settings.welcomeText: Before you lies the old guestbook of the tavern. Here you can review your entries, update personal information, and manage the records kept about you. Every change is carefully documented by the scribes of the house.
settings.deleteTitle: Strike Your Name from the Guestbook
settings.deleteQuestion: Do new adventures call for you, and do you wish to leave the tavern of NJ Brew behind?
settings.deleteDescription:
Do you wish not only to leave the tavern, but also to erase all traces of your journey?

At your request, the scribes of the tavern will remove all records concerning you from the guestbook. Be aware that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
